content:
Following yesterday's system update that included security fixes, Apple today released the security content details for Safari 26.6.1. The following is the relevant information.

Codex appears in the acknowledgement list of multiple CVEs

Apple today updated its "Apple security releases" webpage, listing the vulnerability fix details for Safari 26.6.1, which is now applicable to macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia.

According to the document, this update involves a total of 22 CVEs, all related to WebKit, including two vulnerabilities where "processing specially crafted malicious web content could lead to memory corruption".

Notably, consistent with recent security update trends, OpenAI Codex Security appears nine times on the list, further reflecting the increasingly important role of AI tools in helping to uncover security flaws in Apple software.

Below is the complete security content for Safari 26.6.1 as published by Apple:

Safari 26.6.1 Released: August 18, 2026 WebKit Available for: macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia Impact: Processing specially crafted malicious web content could lead to unexpected Safari crash Description: An out-of-bounds access issue was addressed with improved bounds checking. WebKit Bugzilla: 317632 CVE-2026-64784: Janggoon Lee (Out of Bounds), OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: The issue was addressed with improved memory handling. WebKit Bugzilla: 313452 CVE-2026-43795: wwwlk WebKit Bugzilla: 318348 CVE-2026-65338: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Impact: Processing specially crafted malicious web content could lead to memory corruption WebKit Bugzilla: 318405 CVE-2026-65341: Henock Habte WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed with improved locking. WebKit Bugzilla: 321480 CVE-2026-64782: Seonwook Kim, Shubham Chaskar, lattice, Josef Korbel WebKit Description: The issue was addressed with improved input validation. WebKit Bugzilla: 321484 CVE-2026-64781: Thomas Guillem WebKit Description: The issue was addressed with improved state management. WebKit Bugzilla: 321517 CVE-2026-65351: Niels Hofmans WebKit Bugzilla: 316996 CVE-2026-65340: Claudio Bozzato and Francesco Benvenuto (Cisco Talos), Josef Korbel (Citadelo) WebKit Bugzilla: 317142 CVE-2026-65337: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317349 CVE-2026-65336: Josef Korbel WebKit Bugzilla: 316723 CVE-2026-65335: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317603 CVE-2026-65333: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317450 CVE-2026-65332: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317611 CVE-2026-65331: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Impact: Processing specially crafted malicious web content could lead to unexpected program termination Description: A use-after-free issue was addressed with improved memory management. WebKit Bugzilla: 316347 CVE-2026-64715: Hossein Lotfi (@hosselot) (TrendAI Zero Day Initiative) WebKit Description: The issue was addressed with improved checks. WebKit Bugzilla: 316918 CVE-2026-64780: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed with improved state management. WebKit Bugzilla: 316791 CVE-2026-65334: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed with improved memory handling. WebKit Bugzilla: 317317 CVE-2026-43794: Dung Do (@_piers2) (Calif.io) WebKit Impact: Processing specially crafted malicious web content could lead to unexpected program termination WebKit Bugzilla: 313703 CVE-2026-64787: 杉山 壮太, Shubham Chaskar WebKit History Impact: Visiting a specially crafted malicious website could leak sensitive data WebKit Bugzilla: 315528 CVE-2026-64778: Mohit Negi WebKit Storage WebKit Bugzilla: 321485 CVE-2026-64779: Shubham Chaskar, Tommy DeVoss (Braze Security Team) (@thedawgyg) Additional recognition WebKit We would like to acknowledge Henock Habte for their assistance.
